items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: He came to New York City in 1966 as a member of Don Cherry’s free jazz quintet

ctx.x: And then he came down to the club where we played with Don Cherry. That’s how we met Ornette. So that was ’65.
